caption:
50 AI agents were told to build a thriving civilization in Minecraft. A missing piece of chicken led to a written food handoff protocol. Later, four agents spent 11 minutes picking who could fertilize one wheat block.

That was Civ50, an experiment by YC Labs and Olam Labs. If you were on that server, what rule would you scrap first?
